title: Letters from Spain
author: Joseph Blanco White

authorInfo.bio: Joseph Blanco White (1775–1841) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Letters from Spain" by Joseph Blanco White is a collection of personal observations and reflections written in the early 19th century. The text presents a unique perspective on Spanish life, manners, customs, and religion, as seen through the eyes of a native who has lived abroad.
longDescription: Source subjects: Spain -- Description and travel.
